_comment_tts_voice: Microsoft Edge neural voice short-name. Full list: run `edge-tts --list-voices`. Empfehlung DE: Killian/Conrad (m), Katja/Amala (w). EN: AndrewMultilingual, Jenny.
_comment_tts_rate: Speech speed. '+10%' = etwas schneller (mehr Shorts-Energy), '-10%' = ruhiger.
_comment_tts_pitch: Pitch shift. '+2Hz' = etwas heller, '-2Hz' = etwas tiefer. 0 lässt die Stimme natürlich.
_comment_gemini_moments: Set to 'gemini-2.5-pro' for noticeably better multi-clip moment picks at the cost of more free-tier quota per run. Defaults to gemini_model when empty.
